clips.title: Rivian R2交付启动 下半年放量成关键
title_lines: 试驾热潮能否转化订单

subtitles.en: Just a really big moment, you know, R2 going out into the world.
subtitles.zh: 这确实是个重要时刻，R2正式亮相。

subtitles.en: What does that look like for the CFO? You know, you talk about 3,000 delivery gain in early July.
subtitles.zh: 对CFO来说这意味着什么？你提到7月初交付量增加了3000辆。

subtitles.en: What was the contribution of R2 to sales? What was it like for you towards the end of the quarter to say, this is tangibly what I have to show for R2's launch?
subtitles.zh: R2对销售的贡献如何？季度末时，你如何直观地展示R2上市带来的成果？

subtitles.en: Well, we're really excited about the opportunity to both introduce R2 to the world in June.
subtitles.zh: 我们非常兴奋能在6月向全球推出R2。

subtitles.en: So it's the start of our first external customer deliveries. Also the first opportunity for consumers to test drive the vehicle as well. And we're able to complete 57,000 demo drives over the course
subtitles.zh: 这是我们首批外部客户交付的开始，也是消费者首次有机会试驾。第二季度我们完成了5.7万次试驾。

subtitles.en: of the second quarter. And R2 is a key enabler and driver of the increase that we saw in our demo drive and traffic across each of our retail locations and spaces. And the reaction from the media has
subtitles.zh: R2是推动我们各零售点试驾量和客流增长的关键因素。媒体反响非常热烈。

subtitles.en: just been fantastic. And the same is true as we looked at the feedback that we're seeing from consumers who are getting behind the wheel experiencing it for themselves. And for someone like myself
subtitles.zh: 消费者亲自体验后的反馈同样出色。对我这样已在这里工作五年半的人来说，看到R2上路真是激动人心。

subtitles.en: that's been here for five and a half years now, just a really great moment to see R2 out into the wild
subtitles.zh: R2已经准备好在下半年扩大生产。

subtitles.en: and now ready in an imposition to scale up production over the second half of the year.
subtitles.zh: 克莱尔，你追踪这5.7万次试驾的转化率吗？有多少最终成为实际销售？

subtitles.en: Claire, do you track the conversion rate of those 57,000 demos how many end up being actual sales?
subtitles.zh: 克莱尔，你追踪那5.7万次试驾的转化率吗？其中有多少最终成为实际销售？

entities.evidence: Official company page and Yahoo Finance use Rivian; Chinese media commonly retain English name.

clip_research.source_claim: R2 is a key enabler and driver of the increase in demo drives and traffic, and the company is ready to scale up production over the second half of the year.
clip_research.public_baseline: R2 deliveries began in June 2025, and the company reported 57,000 demo drives in Q2 2025, with plans to ramp production in H2 2025.

evidence.query: Rivian R2 first customer deliveries June 2025
evidence.fact: R2 order invites, demo drives, and first customer deliveries began June 9, 2025.
Rivian hosted more than 57,000 demo drives in Q2, a record up 104% year over year.

evidence.query: Rivian R2 production ramp second half 2025
evidence.fact: Rivian CFO Claire McDonough said production will start cautiously with a single shift, ramping in the second half of the year.

forbidden_claims: R2 deliveries started exactly on June 9, 2025 (some sources say 'soon after').
R2 production ramp is guaranteed to meet targets.

notes: Rivian's official Chinese name is rarely used; English 'Rivian' is standard in Chinese financial media.
R2 is a product model; Chinese media typically keep alphanumeric model names in English.
Claire McDonough is the CFO; title label 'CFO' is safe for video titles.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
